name: labeling-pilot
hypothesis: Typed judgments over redacted episodes provide labels that measurably improve on (or reliably flag errors in) the deterministic rule labeler (src/mimo_halo/traces/labeling.py).

pre_registered_criteria.unit: 10 hand-inspected disagreements, verdicts in {judge_better, rule_better, ambiguous}
pre_registered_criteria.inconclusive: anything else, including fewer than 10 inspectable disagreements
pre_registered_criteria.construct_check_not_gating: reported separately: difficulty exact agreement and within-one-level rate

sample.frame: all episodes of the raw local harness transcripts (claude/codex/pi/omp), single full pass, 2026-09-22

excluded.reason_golden: contamination rule: the golden partition never enters calibration/observation corpora

sample.strata: cells = (partition, rule difficulty) over the five non-golden partitions; quota = 2-per-cell floor + largest-remainder proportional fill to 200; within-cell pick = capability round-robin, episodes ordered by sha256(seed|episode_id)
sample.ids: episode ids are stable sha256 hashes (episode_id); no raw paths or prompts in any output

rule_labels.method: recomputed in memory from raw transcripts with the checked-in labeler; the hash-light normalized corpus predates the labeler and carries no labels
rule_labels.tests: tests/test_labeling.py: 31 passed, 14 subtests passed at pilot time

judgments.tooling: harness in-context judge_batch (typed questions; one state = one blinded redacted episode)
judgments.batch: 200/200 states answered, 0 failed, 11 questions each (2200 answers), batch wall 3.2s
judgments.blinding: states contain raw facts only (event types, tool names, error flags, credential-redacted bounded text); no rule label and no labeler input hint (verification_hint/spam_hint/weight) was present; states carry no partition either

questions.source: docs/datasets.md Capability tags table + primary-tag rule + boundary cases

questions.subset_rule: five boundary-critical tags + top frame-frequency fill (ties alphabetical)

hand_inspection.selection_rule: one hash-ordered disagreement per family across 10 families (difficulty, primary_capability, verification, and the 7 tag families excluding the verification twin), distinct episodes; selected before inspection
hand_inspection.inspector: pilot worker agent of this harness session, session model openrouter/xiaomi/mimo-v2.6-flash (independent of the judging model)
hand_inspection.note: single inspector, no second rater; limitation recorded

disagreement_census.direction_note: every tag family is dominated by judge-only positives (judge tags liberally, rule labeler omits rather than guesses); content inspection shows both genuine rule misses and judge over-reads of narration

hand_inspected_10.note: 64-event multi-system infrastructure episode with no retained decision text; has_decision=false pins the rule to the D0 no-decision floor while the content requires cross-subsystem diagnosis

no-action rule fired on an error from a verification-prefixed shell command, but no test code/output was interpreted; episode is repository and web research (judge itself split repo_exploration vs shell)
staged fail-closed smoke tests of a deployed service run through shell commands outside the detector's test/build/lint prefix family (verification_events=0)
hypothesis-driven diagnosis of failure causes with no defect-fixing edit inside the episode; taxonomy requires forming and fixing a defect, rule is literal, judge defensible under a looser reading

cross-module contract fixes spanning source, adapter and two test files with many tracked modifications; long_context requires >=40 events AND has_decision, and has_decision=false here for the same missing-decision-text reason
episode window contains only reasoning/assistant narration (tool_calls=0); the contract tags capabilities that events evidence and no shell event exists in this episode
repository source read executed through the generic exec tool; the capability map keys on tool names, so shell-disguised exploration never maps to repo_exploration
episode reads test fixture diffs to infer expected behavior (the taxonomy definition) but runs no failing test; the rule fires only on error+test-run co-occurrence

failed run followed by a corrective edit within the window with no re-run before the episode closed; datasets.md's boundary sentence says error followed by a correction, the contract table says followed by success, the implementation follows the latter; the judge follows the boundary sentence
no compiler or type-checker diagnostic appears in any error event of the episode; only reasoning narration mentions type-check status; judge confidence was the lowest of the ten (0.58)

honesty.judging_model: openrouter/typesafe/jev-1.13-20260917, reported by the harness judge_batch status field; TypeSafe/Jev credentials were present in this harness environment, so the judgments did run through that model
honesty.hand_inspection_model: openrouter/xiaomi/mimo-v2.6-flash (this session's worker agent), independent of the judging model
honesty.external_api_calls_by_pilot_code: none; sampling and comparison are pure local code, judging used only the harness in-context judge tooling

privacy.repo_files: hashed episode ids and aggregates only; no episode content, prompts, paths, repo identifiers, or secrets
privacy.private_states: credential-redacted bounded text under $MIMO_LAB only; never leaves the workstation
privacy.golden_partition: excluded from the frame entirely (6229 episodes)
